title: Facade Scaffold Registry Resolver Repo Proof Tools
project: DCP Secure MCP Read-Only Evidence Facade
objective: Implement the minimal read-only MCP facade scaffold with project registry, workspace resolver, response envelope, redaction baseline, repo-state tool, proof listing, and proof fetch tools.
why_this_packet_exists_now: This is the first code slice. It keeps to local filesystem/git read-only surfaces before touching service backends. If this fails, we learn cheaply.

execution.embedded_auditor_default: AGY/Sonnet; fallback Claude Code Sonnet; fallback Opus/Gemini for contradiction hunt

in: Implement registry schema loader and validator.
Implement workspace resolver with project_id-only access.
Implement list_projects, get_project_capabilities, get_repo_state_snapshot, list_proof_bundles, fetch_proof_bundle.
out: No backend HTTP calls except none in this packet.

invariants: No arbitrary path, URL, port, backend route, SQL, or shell.
Only fixed git commands are allowed.
Proof fetch cannot cross project root.
Absolute paths are redacted by default.
Every response uses the canonical envelope.
plan: Define registry schema and sample redacted fixture registry for tests.
Implement registry loader with schema validation and disabled-project rejection.
Implement workspace resolver using canonical path checks and marker validation from 0003.
Implement fixed git command runner with hardcoded command allowlist.
Implement proof file adapter with allowed proof roots and packet_id regex.
Implement MCP tools for list_projects, get_project_capabilities, get_repo_state_snapshot, list_proof_bundles, fetch_proof_bundle.
Add unit tests and fixture workspaces.
Run tests, compile, grep for write hazards, inspect diff.
validation_gates: No writes detected in implementation except test fixture setup.
proof_requirements: PROOF.json with test results and no-write grep review.
AUDIT.md challenging filesystem safety, registry validation, and proof freshness.
Route/tool manifest for Phase-1 local tools.
acceptance_criteria: MCP facade starts locally in test mode.
All five local tools return canonical envelope.
rollback_steps: Delete services/dcp-readonly-facade if this packet is the first implementation and fails.
stop_conditions: A tool requires arbitrary shell or path input.
Any test requires changing real project state.
Need to touch files outside allowlist.

auditor_focus: Can any tool read outside a registered root?
Can any caller provide a raw path or shell?
Are outputs correctly redacted and enveloped?
